prompt: Given array `nums = [1, 2, 1, 1, 1]` where `nums[i]` is the maximum jump length from index `i`, what is the minimum number of jumps needed to reach the last index (`4`)?
explanation: Using BFS level-by-level greedy interval expansion, each jump extends to the farthest reachable boundary. Reaching index 4 requires at minimum 3 jump(s).
